requirements.text: पात्रता मानदंड: The bidder shall have a minimum average annual turnover of Rs. 31,20,00,000 in the last three financial years.
The bidder shall submit an EMD of Rs. 62,40,000 by RTGS or a bank guarantee valid for 180 days.
The bidder shall have at least 5 years of experience executing highway strengthening works of similar nature.
The bidder shall be enrolled on the Central Public Procurement Portal with a valid Class 3 Digital Signature Certificate.
The bidder shall not be under any debarment or blacklisting by NHAI, MoRTH or any state PWD on the bid due date.
6.1 The contractor shall strengthen 48.6 km of the existing carriageway including shoulders and cross drainage works.
6.2 The contractor shall complete the work within 18 months of the appointed date.
6.3 The contractor must establish a field laboratory at site and test materials at the frequency in the MoRTH specifications.
6.4 The contractor shall maintain the completed work during a defect liability period of 60 months.
6.5 The contractor shall deploy the key personnel named in the bid and seek written approval before any replacement.
6.6 The contractor should submit a monthly safety report covering incidents, near misses and corrective actions.
Each uploaded file shall be in PDF format and shall not exceed 25 MB.
Technical and financial bids shall be uploaded on the CPP Portal before 03:00 PM IST on 11-12-2026.
The bidder shall digitally sign both covers with a Class 3 DSC issued to the authorised signatory.
The bidder shall upload an affidavit of non-blacklisting and a power of attorney for the signatory.
The original bank guarantee towards EMD shall reach the Regional Office before the bid opening date.
Financial bids of technically qualified bidders only will be opened and the lowest evaluated bid will be considered.
Technical evaluation will assess completed similar works, bid capacity and the deployment of key personnel.
